title: Hyde and EEK Boutique Skull Lava Lamp Bat Topper Green Halloween Target 2024 New
descriptionText:
Hyde and EEK! Boutique green skull lava lamp with a black bat stopper on top, from Target's 2024 Halloween collection (item 240-43-1546, $20 retail). Green skull base with orange eyes and pink teeth, clear glitter lava globe, black bat cap. Battery operated. New with the Try Me! tag still attached - tested and working. Stands about 11 inches tall.

Condition: New, tag attached. Please review the photos - they are of the actual item you will receive.
